hero.title: Change your life and habits
hero.description: Hey, I'm Maria 😊 I'll help you befriend the gym and find the right type of training that matches your preferences and goals.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I specialize in strength training with free weights and machines, functional training, Tabata, stretching, and mobility. I combine all of these to create professional training plans tailored to you.
about.paragraph2: Every plan is created individually, considering your abilities, experience, past injuries, and lifestyle. I focus on real goals, conscious progress, and a healthy approach to physical activity.
about.location: Poznań, Xtreme Fitness Stary Browar (Multisport card accepted)

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Whether you want to lose weight, slim your thighs, build glutes, sweat less, learn technique, or just be more fit — message me and I'll take care of it.
faq.a1: I'll create a training plan tailored to your needs and abilities.
faq.q2: Can I start training with no experience?
faq.a2: Absolutely! Every plan is created individually, taking your experience level into account.
faq.q3: Where do training sessions take place?
faq.a3: Poznań, Xtreme Fitness Stary Browar. Multisport card accepted.
faq.a4: We'll have a great time 💪 I focus on a healthy and enjoyable approach to physical activity.
